# LearningPlaywrightFundamentals

Hands-on learning project for the [Playwright](https://playwright.dev/) end-to-end testing framework, built with `@playwright/test` and TypeScript.

## Overview

This repository collects practice specs that exercise Playwright fundamentals: page navigation, role-based and test-id locators, web-first assertions, and a full login flow against a public demo application.

## Prerequisites

- [Node.js](https://nodejs.org/) (LTS recommended)
- npm

## Installation

```bash
npm install
npx playwright install chromium
```

The second command downloads the Chromium binary required by the configured project.

## Configuration

From `playwright.config.ts`:

| Setting | Value |
| --- | --- |
| `testDir` | `./tests` |
| `fullyParallel` | `true` |
| `retries` | `process.env.CI ? 2 : 0` |
| `workers` | `process.env.CI ? 1 : undefined` |
| `reporter` | `html` |
| `trace` | `on-first-retry` |
| `headless` | `false` |
| Projects | `chromium` |

Failures produce artifacts under `test-results/`, and traces are captured when a test is retried.

## Dependencies

Development:

- `@playwright/test` ^1.63.0
- `@types/node` ^26.5.1

| Command | Runs |
| --- | --- |

## Running Tests

```bash
npx playwright test                      # all tests
npx playwright test tests/example.spec.ts # a single spec
npx playwright test --headed             # show the browser
npx playwright test --ui                 # interactive UI mode
npx playwright show-report               # open the last HTML report
```

## Regenerating This README

```bash
npm run readme:sync
```

The command walks the working tree, reads `playwright.config.ts`, `package.json`, and every `tests/**/*.spec.ts`, then rewrites this file.
